text: よいくすりが　できそうじゃわい！

structure.en: looks like it can be made!

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう stuck onto the stem of an action word means 'looks like it will'. できそう = 'looks like it can be made'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man だ, and わい after it is an old-man ending that shows feeling. できそうじゃわい = 'looks like I can make it, oh yes!'.
